_comment: Words people actually type, written by hand before the site has any traffic to learn from. Keyed by <section key>/<category slug.es>, because several sections share a slug (limpieza, mudanzas, belleza...). Seeded into categories.synonyms together with seeds/taxonomy.json; what the site learns later lives apart, in categories.extra_synonyms. Rules: never a word that fits half the board (робота, продам, Іспанія) — a word here attaches itself to every ad of the category.
_note_uk_ru: The Ukrainian and Russian lists carry the mixed speech of people living in Spain: Spanish words written in Cyrillic (гестор, падрон, камарера, канхе, пеон, фінка). Nobody types 'gestoría' on a Ukrainian keyboard, and that is exactly the search that used to find nothing.
